newsitem.title: USA: Avis executive outraged over race bias charge.
newsitem.headline: Avis executive outraged over race bias charge.

text.p: Joseph Vittoria, chairman and chief executive of car rental company Avis Inc, a recently acquired unit of HFS Inc, said on Wednesday that he is outraged that a North Carolina franchisee refused to rent cars to African-Americans.
"I am outraged and profoundly troubled by the allegations that a North Carolina-based franchisee has refused to rent cars based on racial considerations," Vittoria said.
Avis is conducting an investigation into the matter and would not tolerate continuation of this franchise if the charges are found to be true, the company said.

A lawsuit was filed yesterday that accused the owner of five franchises instructed employees to find reasons not to rent vehicles to African-Americans. Attorneys for the 85 people are suing Avis and the franchisee, John Dalton, in the case for unspecified damages.
